def unitpulse(p,duty=0.28,nh=10):
    p=np.asarray(p)
    w=2*duty-1
    for h in range(1,nh+1):
        w=w+(4/np.pi/h)*np.sin(np.pi*h*duty)*np.cos(2*np.pi*h*(p-duty/2))

    n=int(cycles*PERIOD)
    cyc=np.arange(n)/PERIOD
    y=synth(cyc)

    last=min(64,n//5)
    y[-last:]*=np.linspace(1,0,last)**2
    return limit(y,peak)

        y+=0.045*np.sin(2*(k-1)*x+0.8)+0.04*np.sin(2*(k+1)*x-1.1)
    else:
        y+=0.075*np.sin(4*k*x+0.4)+0.044*np.sin(6*k*x+0.25)
    # attack from silence; no 'envelope mapping' used, this is in the PCM
    y[:attack]*=np.sin(np.linspace(0,np.pi/2,attack))**2

def arp(variant):
    def fn(c):
        p=2*np.pi*c
        env=np.exp(-c/40)
        wave=(0.65*np.sin(p)+0.23*np.sin(2*p+(.2 if variant==0 else .85))*np.exp(-c/25)
              +0.15*np.sin(3*p-.37)*np.exp(-c/18)
              +0.075*np.sin(5*p+.7)*np.exp(-c/11))
        if variant:
            wave+=0.14*np.sin(p+1.0*np.sin(2.02*p)*np.exp(-c/13))*np.exp(-c/30)
        else:
            wave+=0.09*unitpulse(c%1,.21,10)*np.exp(-c/9)
        return wave*env*(1-np.exp(-c/0.45))
    return one_cycles(190,fn,peak=24000)

def lead():
    attack=PERIOD*24
    n=np.arange(attack+PERIOD)
    c=n/PERIOD
    duty=np.where(n<attack,.18+.12*np.minimum(1,c/18),.30)
    # smooth pulse duty from .18 to .30 in the attack, stable loop thereafter
    pulse=np.array([unitpulse(z%1,float(d),10) for z,d in zip(c,duty)])
    y=(0.46*np.sin(2*np.pi*c-0.10)+0.46*pulse+
       0.08*np.sin(2*np.pi*3*c+.35))
    y[:attack]*=(.38+.62*(1-np.exp(-c[:attack]/4)))
    y[:PERIOD*2]*=np.sin(np.linspace(0,np.pi/2,PERIOD*2))**2
    return limit(y,23000),(attack,PERIOD)

def lead_echo():
    def fn(c):
        return (0.7*np.sin(2*np.pi*c-.1)+0.18*np.sin(6*np.pi*c+.3)+
                0.18*unitpulse(c%1,.34,7)*np.exp(-c/40))*\
               np.exp(-c/56)*(1-np.exp(-c/1.1))
    return one_cycles(230,fn,peak=22000)

def bell():
    def fn(c):
        x=2*np.pi*c
        a=np.sin(x+1.65*np.exp(-c/27)*np.sin(2.015*x+0.2))
        y=(.74*a*np.exp(-c/54)+.24*np.sin(2.01*x+0.7)*np.exp(-c/22)
             +.16*np.sin(3.96*x+1.5)*np.exp(-c/18))
        return y*(1-np.exp(-c/0.5))
    return one_cycles(260,fn,peak=20500)

def stab(variant):
    def fn(c):
        x=2*np.pi*c
        a=.58*np.sin(x+1.15*np.exp(-c/11)*np.sin(2*x+.4*variant))
        b=.22*unitpulse(c%1,.37+(0.03 if variant else 0),7)*np.exp(-c/12)
        return (a+b+.16*np.sin(3*x+.6)*np.exp(-c/9))*\
                np.exp(-c/20)*(1-np.exp(-c/.35))
    return one_cycles(105,fn,peak=23500)

def flute():

    p=2*np.pi*c

    y[:attack]*=0.55+0.45*(1-np.exp(-c[:attack]/7))
    y[:PERIOD*7]*=np.sin(np.linspace(0,np.pi/2,PERIOD*7))**2
    return limit(y,22300),(attack,PERIOD)

def sparkle():
    def fn(c):
        x=2*np.pi*c
        return (0.53*np.sin(x)+.3*np.sin(2.01*x+.7)*np.exp(-c/15)+
                .16*np.sin(5.21*x+1.1)*np.exp(-c/10))*\
               np.exp(-c/35)*(1-np.exp(-c/.3))
    return one_cycles(165,fn,peak=19200)

def thump():
    def fn(c):
        x=2*np.pi*c
        return .97*np.sin(x-0.14)*np.exp(-c/26)*(1-np.exp(-c/.55))
    return one_cycles(75,fn,peak=25000)

def hi_noise(n, hp=20):
    z=rng.standard_normal(n)
    smooth=np.convolve(z,np.ones(hp)/hp,'same')
    return z-smooth

def kick():
    t=np.arange(int(.45*SR))/SR
    f=48+163*np.exp(-t/.018)+18*np.exp(-t/.13)
    phase=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/SR
    a=(.88*np.sin(phase)*np.exp(-t/.115)+.19*np.sin(phase*.49)*np.exp(-t/.18))
    click=hi_noise(len(t),12)*np.exp(-t/.003)*.14
    return limit((a+click)*(1-np.exp(-t/.00075)),peak=26900)

def snare():
    t=np.arange(int(.31*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),27)
    # offset clap grains at 19 and 35 ms add a little analog 'smack'
    burst=(.64*np.exp(-t/.039)+
           .33*np.exp(-np.maximum(t-.018,0)/.024)*(t>=.018)+
           .24*np.exp(-np.maximum(t-.039,0)/.028)*(t>=.039))
    tone=np.sin(2*np.pi*(188*t-29*t*t))*np.exp(-t/.051)
    a=.76*z*burst+.46*tone
    a*=1-np.exp(-t/.00055)
    return limit(a,peak=23200)

def hat(opened=False):
    t=np.arange(int((.39 if opened else .14)*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),15)
    metallic=(np.sin(2*np.pi*4200*t)+.7*np.sin(2*np.pi*5731*t)+
              .45*np.sin(2*np.pi*7720*t))*np.exp(-t/.020)
    decay=.109 if opened else .031
    a=(z+.16*metallic)*np.exp(-t/decay)*(1-np.exp(-t/.00045))
    return limit(a,peak=20500 if opened else 17400)

def tom():
    t=np.arange(int(.30*SR))/SR
    freq=128+560*np.exp(-t/.020)
    phi=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(freq)/SR
    a=(np.sin(phi)+.15*np.sin(2*phi))*np.exp(-t/.076)
    a+=hi_noise(len(t),18)*.065*np.exp(-t/.008)
    return limit(a*(1-np.exp(-t/.0007)),peak=22500)

def rim():
    t=np.arange(int(.12*SR))/SR
    freq=485-160*t
    phi=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(freq)/SR
    a=.57*np.sin(phi)*np.exp(-t/.025)+.72*hi_noise(len(t),12)*np.exp(-t/.009)
    return limit(a*(1-np.exp(-t/.0003)),peak=19500)

def splash():
    t=np.arange(int(.96*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),35)
    met=np.sin(2*np.pi*3433*t)+.7*np.sin(2*np.pi*4597*t)+.5*np.sin(2*np.pi*6611*t)
    a=(z+.12*met)*(.5*np.exp(-t/.23)+.32*np.exp(-t/.53))
    return limit(a*(1-np.exp(-t/.001)),peak=20200)

def sweep():
    t=np.arange(int(.77*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),55)
    # amplitude rises right up to the following pattern downbeat
    a=(.75*z+.17*np.sin(2*np.pi*(950*t+2800*t*t)))*((t/.77)**1.8)
    a*=np.minimum(1,(.77-t)/.013)
    return limit(a,peak=18300)

def put(p,r,ch,n=None,i=None,v=None,e=None,ep=0):
    if not 0<=p<N_PAT or not 0<=r<64 or not 0<=ch<NCH:
        raise IndexError((p,r,ch))
    if n is not None: n=note(n)
    if v is not None: assert 0<=v<=64,(p,r,ch,v)
    nv=(n or 0, i or 0, v+0x10 if v is not None else 0, e or 0, ep)
    old=GRID[p][r][ch]
    if old is not None:
        raise ValueError(f'cell overlap {p}:{r}:{ch} {old} and {nv}')
    GRID[p][r][ch]=nv

def line(p,bar,ch,i,s,level=50,rv=None):

    for x in s.split():

        row=int(pieces[0]); nm=pieces[1]
        v=int(pieces[2]) if len(pieces)>2 else level
        put(p,bar*16+row,ch,nm,i,v)

    return one_cycles(165,fn,peak=19200)

def thump():
    def fn(c):
        x=2*np.pi*c
        return .97*np.sin(x-0.14)*np.exp(-c/26)*(1-np.exp(-c/.55))
    return one_cycles(75,fn,peak=25000)

def hi_noise(n, hp=20):
    z=rng.standard_normal(n)
    smooth=np.convolve(z,np.ones(hp)/hp,'same')
    return z-smooth

def kick():
    t=np.arange(int(.45*SR))/SR
    f=48+163*np.exp(-t/.018)+18*np.exp(-t/.13)
    phase=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/SR
    a=(.88*np.sin(phase)*np.exp(-t/.115)+.19*np.sin(phase*.49)*np.exp(-t/.18))
    click=hi_noise(len(t),12)*np.exp(-t/.003)*.14
    return limit((a+click)*(1-np.exp(-t/.00075)),peak=26900)

def snare():
    t=np.arange(int(.31*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),27)
    # offset clap grains at 19 and 35 ms add a little analog 'smack'
    burst=(.64*np.exp(-t/.039)+
           .33*np.exp(-np.maximum(t-.018,0)/.024)*(t>=.018)+
           .24*np.exp(-np.maximum(t-.039,0)/.028)*(t>=.039))
    tone=np.sin(2*np.pi*(188*t-29*t*t))*np.exp(-t/.051)
    a=.76*z*burst+.46*tone
    a*=1-np.exp(-t/.00055)
    return limit(a,peak=23200)

def hat(opened=False):
    t=np.arange(int((.39 if opened else .14)*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),15)
    metallic=(np.sin(2*np.pi*4200*t)+.7*np.sin(2*np.pi*5731*t)+
              .45*np.sin(2*np.pi*7720*t))*np.exp(-t/.020)
    decay=.109 if opened else .031
    a=(z+.16*metallic)*np.exp(-t/decay)*(1-np.exp(-t/.00045))
    return limit(a,peak=20500 if opened else 17400)

def tom():
    t=np.arange(int(.30*SR))/SR
    freq=128+560*np.exp(-t/.020)
    phi=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(freq)/SR
    a=(np.sin(phi)+.15*np.sin(2*phi))*np.exp(-t/.076)
    a+=hi_noise(len(t),18)*.065*np.exp(-t/.008)
    return limit(a*(1-np.exp(-t/.0007)),peak=22500)

def rim():
    t=np.arange(int(.12*SR))/SR
    freq=485-160*t
    phi=2*np.pi*np.cumsum(freq)/SR
    a=.57*np.sin(phi)*np.exp(-t/.025)+.72*hi_noise(len(t),12)*np.exp(-t/.009)
    return limit(a*(1-np.exp(-t/.0003)),peak=19500)

def splash():
    t=np.arange(int(.96*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),35)
    met=np.sin(2*np.pi*3433*t)+.7*np.sin(2*np.pi*4597*t)+.5*np.sin(2*np.pi*6611*t)
    a=(z+.12*met)*(.5*np.exp(-t/.23)+.32*np.exp(-t/.53))
    return limit(a*(1-np.exp(-t/.001)),peak=20200)

def sweep():
    t=np.arange(int(.77*SR))/SR
    z=hi_noise(len(t),55)
    # amplitude rises right up to the following pattern downbeat
    a=(.75*z+.17*np.sin(2*np.pi*(950*t+2800*t*t)))*((t/.77)**1.8)
    a*=np.minimum(1,(.77-t)/.013)
    return limit(a,peak=18300)

GRID=[[[None]*NCH for _ in range(64)] for _ in range(N_PAT)]

def put(p,r,ch,n=None,i=None,v=None,e=None,ep=0):
    if not 0<=p<N_PAT or not 0<=r<64 or not 0<=ch<NCH:
        raise IndexError((p,r,ch))
    if n is not None: n=note(n)
    if v is not None: assert 0<=v<=64,(p,r,ch,v)
    nv=(n or 0, i or 0, v+0x10 if v is not None else 0, e or 0, ep)
    old=GRID[p][r][ch]
    if old is not None:
        raise ValueError(f'cell overlap {p}:{r}:{ch} {old} and {nv}')
    GRID[p][r][ch]=nv

        v=int(pieces[2]) if len(pieces)>2 else level

       struct.pack('<HH',0,0)+bytes(20))

    looplen=0 if loop is None else loop[1]*2

       struct.pack('<BbBBbB',vol,fine,0x11 if loop else 0x10,pan,rel,0)+label(name,22))

    return h+s+delta.tobytes()

    if cell is None:return b'\x80'
    flags=0x80
    for j,x in enumerate(cell):
        if x:flags|=(1<<j)
    return bytes([flags])+bytes(x for j,x in enumerate(cell) if x)
